context:
Goal: a lane in a cloud session can mark its own PR ready, or the rule says plainly why not.
Problem (rule): The coordinator asked for the cloud ready-mark debt to point to decision lane-may-mark-ready. Triage read main: no decision file has that name; it is only a guard test family in hooks/test_guard.py. The debt in draft PR #3622 points to draft-until-reviewed (ruling Q2) instead.
Departs from: main, where no decision named lane-may-mark-ready exists; a keeps that, b adds a decision file.
Waiting on: nothing stopped.
Closed 12:20 CST Nov 17: pick a, taken by triage 11 on the consultant's word (the name was a typo for the guard test family; no decision is missing; a reversible home pick the record already answers). Not an owner answer. The debt stays on draft-until-reviewed (ruling Q2).

options.gain: No new record; PR #3622 can merge as written.
options.how: The debt cites the existing ruling. No new decision.
options.label: Keep the debt on draft-until-reviewed
options.lose: The name the coordinator and lane used stays unwritten.

options.gain: The name in use has a home you can read.
options.how: A record-writer adds the decision file; the debt cites it.
options.label: Write a decision named lane-may-mark-ready and point the debt to it
options.lose: One more decision file, and PR #3622 waits for it.

ref: decision lane-may-mark-ready (named by the coordinator 11:16 CST Nov 17, no file on main); decision draft-until-reviewed (ruling Q2)
short: Which decision owns the ready mark?

title: The ready-mark debt cites a decision that does not exist on main. Keep the debt on draft-until-reviewed, or write the missing decision?
why: The existing ruling already covers it, so a second decision would repeat it.
